cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Fluent in Nonsense
cards.instruction: Perform complete mastery of the strange logic while inventing each rule only when it becomes necessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Before we sell this bottled cloud, measure from its third elbow. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm the new assistant. I can only find two.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Naturally. The third appears when addressed by its professional title. Say 'Professor.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Professor. It's raining inside the bottle.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. Those are its credentials. Count the drops; that gives us its sleeve size.

mechanism: A leads cloud measurement and helps a new assistant while inventing expert rules to turn missing anatomy and rain into usable measurements.
confusable: Unlike seeking a true rule through tests, A asserts complete prior mastery of rules invented after each result.
comparison: Measuring a cloud for sale differs from repairing gravity through social etiquette.
seedUse: D162-a bottled cloud, third elbow and Professor; S02-a handles equipment and recording to keep the novice participating.
